['Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft zur F\u00f6rde.company_description: The Fraunhofer Society is a German research organization with 76 institutes spread throughout Germany, each focusing on different fields of applied science. It has some 30,800 employees, mainly scientists and engineers, and an annual research budget of about €3.0 billion. The organization is the biggest in Europe for applied research and development services. One of its notable institutes is the Fraunhofer Institute for Solar Energy Systems, which performs applied scientific and engineering research and development for all areas of solar energy.
